description: Source code for handling OpenAPI schema definitions, references, and conversions in the Kubernetes kube-openapi project.

classes.name: Definitions
classes.description: Implementation of Models interface, managing schema models and references.

classes.name: Ref
classes.description: Represents a schema reference within the definitions, implementing the Reference interface.

methods.name: newSchemaError
methods.description: Creates a formatted schema error message, including path context if available.

methods.name: VendorExtensionToMap
methods.description: Converts OpenAPI vendor extensions to a map of string to interface{}.

methods.name: NewOpenAPIData
methods.description: Creates Models from an OpenAPI document by parsing definitions.

methods.name: parseReference
methods.description: Parses a schema reference, verifying its validity and returning a Ref object.

methods.name: parseDefault
methods.description: Parses default value from openapi_v2.Any to Go interface{}.

methods.name: parseBaseSchema
methods.description: Creates a BaseSchema from an openapi_v2.Schema.

methods.name: parseMap
methods.description: Parses a schema as a map type.

methods.name: parsePrimitive
methods.description: Parses a schema as a primitive type.

methods.name: parseArray
methods.description: Parses a schema as an array type.

methods.name: parseKind
methods.description: Parses a schema as a structured object with properties.

methods.name: parseArbitrary
methods.description: Parses a schema as an arbitrary value.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Creates a walkable Schema from an openapi_v2.Schema.

methods.name: LookupModel
methods.description: Returns a schema model by name.

methods.name: ListModels
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all model names.

methods.name: Reference
methods.description: Interface implemented by schema reference types.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns a descriptive name for the reference.
